title: The Final Protocol
author: Lior Villalobos
blurb: Sable Fairweather, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
